trends.what: A curated list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's the go-to resource for developers looking to quickly find and integrate third-party services, making it a timeless reference.

trends.what: An open-source platform and curriculum for learning programming, math, and computer science through interactive lessons and projects.
trends.why: It remains a top destination for free, self-paced coding education, especially as demand for accessible tech skills grows.

trends.what: A massive collection of freely available programming books, tutorials, and learning resources in multiple languages.
trends.why: It's a one-stop shop for free learning materials, appealing to budget-conscious learners and educators alike.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your own 'lobster' (independent and self-sufficient).
trends.why: The idea of a fully local, cross-platform AI assistant is exciting as users seek privacy and control over their data.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps and guides that help developers plan their learning paths and career growth in tech.
trends.why: With the fast-changing tech landscape, developers rely on these visual roadmaps to stay updated and focused.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents behave like a lazy senior developer, optimizing for minimal code and avoiding unnecessary work.
trends.why: It's a humorous yet practical take on AI code generation, resonating with devs who value simplicity and efficiency.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive coding agent harness and TUI (terminal user interface) from SpaceXAI for building with AI.
trends.why: It offers a new, immersive way to interact with AI coding agents, appealing to developers who prefer rich terminal experiences.

trends.what: Runs frontier mixture-of-experts (MoE) AI models on existing hardware using pure C with zero dependencies, streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It democratizes access to powerful AI models by making them runnable on consumer hardware, a major breakthrough for local AI.
